definitions.explanation: A state of being crowded with many people or things.

examples.japanese: {道路|どうろ}が{混雑|こんざつ}している。
{連休|れんきゅう}{中|ちゅう}は{観光地|かんこうち}がどこも{混雑|こんざつ}するので、{早|はや}めに{出発|しゅっぱつ}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: Tourist spots get crowded everywhere during the consecutive holidays, so it's better to leave early.

notes:
{混雑|こんざつ} describes crowded conditions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {混雑|こんざつ}している (is congested/crowded)
- {混雑|こんざつ}を{避|さ}ける (avoid crowds)
- {混雑|こんざつ}{時|じ} (peak hours)
- {混雑|こんざつ}{緩和|かんわ} (congestion relief)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {混雑|こんざつ}: congestion, crowding
- {渋滞|じゅうたい}: traffic jam (vehicles)
- {込|こ}み{合|あ}う: to be crowded
